preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)
Attacker must hold some amount of the MemeFarm token to sell
Liquidity pool must exist with sufficient ETH balance for the exploit to be profitable

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first set sell taxes to 100% using setAllTaxes(100,0,0) to trap users' tokens when they sell. Then use qwidji() to blacklist specific addresses (including yourself) to prevent them from selling. Finally, set yourself as fee-exempt using setlsExcIudeFromFee() and sell your tokens tax-free while other users cannot sell or face 100% taxes. Optionally, use changeRouterVeslon() to mint unlimited tokens to yourself if you control the ________ address.
